Where a report's RTF file goes

Source: R/table_spec.R
tfl_report_path.Rd

file.path(study$output_path, report$file), with {output_id} filled: the path rtfreporter::generate_rtfreport() writes to.

Usage

tfl_report_path(spec, output_id = NULL)

Arguments

spec

A report definition (tfl_read_report_spec()) narrowed to one report, or the path(s) to read it from.

output_id

The report, when spec is a path or still defines several.

Value

A single path.

The table engine

The ARD functions and the plan are rtfreporter's: help("ard-tables", package = "rtfreporter").

See also

tfl_report()
